rules.sql: SELECT h.uuid::text AS row_id, h.business_unit, h.security_id, h.source_trade_id, sp.asset_class, sp.invenio_product_code, sp.product_name, sp.exchange_name, sp.lot_mult1, sp.curr_mult1, sp.mult_factor, sp.nc_factor, fx.fx_nc_factor, fx.actual_fx_nc_factor FROM opera.helper_settle_p_and_g_view_cache_table h LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT pm1.asset_class, pm1.invenio_product_code, pm1.product_name, pm1.exchange_name, pm1.lot_mult AS lot_mult1, cm1.curr_mult AS curr_mult1, pm1.murex_mult AS mult_factor, mx.murex_nc_factor AS nc_factor FROM opera.cloned_security_info_table s JOIN opera.valuation_date_table v ON v.tenant_id = s.tenant_id AND v.business_unit = s.business_unit LEFT JOIN opera.cloned_underlying_list_table u1 ON u1.tenant_id = s.tenant_id AND u1.underlying_id = s.underlying1_id LEFT JOIN opera.cloned_underlying_list_table u2 ON u2.tenant_id = s.tenant_id AND u2.underlying_id = s.underlying2_id LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT c.curr_mult FROM opera.curr_mult_view c WHERE c.tenant_id = s.tenant_id AND c.business_unit = s.business_unit AND c.invenio_product_code = s.product_code AND c.value_date = v.value_date OFFSET 0) cm1 ON true LEFT JOIN opera.product_master_table pm1 ON pm1.tenant_id = s.tenant_id AND pm1.invenio_product_code = s.product_code LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT 1 AS one FROM opera.cloned_curr_mult_view c WHERE c.tenant_id = s.tenant_id AND c.business_unit = s.business_unit AND c.invenio_product_code = u2.invenio_product_code AND c.value_date = v.value_date OFFSET 0) cm2 ON true LEFT JOIN opera.cloned_product_master_table pm2 ON pm2.tenant_id = s.tenant_id AND pm2.invenio_product_code = u2.invenio_product_code LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT m.murex_nc_factor FROM opera.murex_nc_factor_view m WHERE m.tenant_id = s.tenant_id AND m.business_unit = s.business_unit AND m.invenio_product_code = s.product_code AND m.value_date = v.value_date OFFSET 0) mx ON true WHERE s.tenant_id = h.tenant_id AND s.business_unit = h.business_unit AND s.security_id = h.security_id AND s.business_unit IN ('orm', 'osg', 'rmc', 'ORM', 'OSG', 'RMC') OFFSET 0 ) sp ON true LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT DISTINCT CASE WHEN LOWER(b.derivative_type) IN ('fx_vanilla_call', 'fx_vanilla_put') THEN 1 WHEN LOWER(b.curr_mult_type) = 'multiplication' AND b.is_fixing_done = 0 THEN 1 WHEN LOWER(b.curr_mult_type) = 'multiplication' AND b.is_fixing_done = 1 THEN ((b.constant_nc_factor * b.fixing_rate) / (b.constant_curr_mult * b.settle_by_curr_mult)) WHEN LOWER(b.curr_mult_type) = 'division' AND b.is_fixing_done = 0 THEN CASE WHEN LOWER(b.business_unit) IN ('orm', 'osg') AND ( LOWER(LEFT(b.derivative_type, 3)) = 'cs_' OR LOWER(LEFT(b.product_code, 5)) IN ('cm ko', 'cm ac', 'cm ae', 'cm vv') ) THEN 1 WHEN LOWER(b.business_unit) IN ('rmc') AND ( LOWER(LEFT(b.derivative_type, 3)) = 'cs_' OR LOWER(LEFT(b.product_code, 5)) IN ('cm ko', 'cm ac', 'cm ae', 'cm vv', 'im rt', 'cm sh', 'cm ak', 'cm bp') OR LOWER(LEFT(b.product_code, 6)) IN ('cm pal', 'cm zrr', 'cm bdr') ) THEN 1 ELSE (b.constant_nc_factor / b.settle_by_underlying) END WHEN LOWER(b.curr_mult_type) = 'division' AND b.is_fixing_done = 1 THEN (b.constant_nc_factor / b.fixing_rate) END AS fx_nc_factor, CASE WHEN LOWER(b.business_unit) IN ('rba', 'rbc', 'rmc') THEN CASE WHEN LOWER(b.derivative_type) IN ('fx_vanilla_call', 'fx_vanilla_put') THEN 1 WHEN LOWER(b.curr_mult_type) = 'multiplication' AND b.is_fixing_done = 0 THEN 1 WHEN LOWER(b.curr_mult_type) = 'multiplication' AND b.is_fixing_done = 1 THEN ((b.constant_nc_factor * b.fixing_rate) / (b.constant_curr_mult * b.actual_by_curr_mult)) WHEN LOWER(b.curr_mult_type) = 'division' AND b.is_fixing_done = 0 THEN CASE WHEN LOWER(b.business_unit) IN ('rmc') AND ( LOWER(LEFT(b.derivative_type, 3)) = 'cs_' OR LOWER(LEFT(b.product_code, 5)) IN ('cm ko', 'cm ac', 'cm ae', 'cm vv', 'im rt', 'cm sh', 'cm ak', 'cm bp') OR LOWER(LEFT(b.product_code, 6)) IN ('cm pal', 'cm zrr', 'cm bdr') ) THEN 1 ELSE (b.constant_nc_factor / b.actual_by_underlying) END WHEN LOWER(b.curr_mult_type) = 'division' AND b.is_fixing_done = 1 THEN (b.constant_nc_factor / b.fixing_rate) END END AS actual_fx_nc_factor FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT d.tenant_id, d.business_unit, d.trade_id, d.is_fixing_done, si.derivative_type, si.product_code, pm.curr_mult_type, pm.constant_nc_factor, pm.constant_curr_mult, ft.fixing_rate, usv_cm.settle_value AS settle_by_curr_mult, usv_u1.settle_value AS settle_by_underlying, uav_cm.settle_value AS actual_by_curr_mult, uav_u1.settle_value AS actual_by_underlying FROM opera.deal_ticket_table_with_fy_premium_view d JOIN opera.valuation_date_table v ON v.tenant_id = d.tenant_id AND v.business_unit = d.business_unit LEFT JOIN opera.security_info_table si ON si.tenant_id = d.tenant_id AND si.business_unit = d.business_unit AND si.security_id = d.security_id LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT x.invenio_product_code FROM opera.helper_invenio_product_code x WHERE x.tenant_id = si.tenant_id AND x.business_unit = si.business_unit AND x.security_id = si.security_id OFFSET 0) hipc ON true LEFT JOIN opera.product_master_table pm ON pm.tenant_id = si.tenant_id AND pm.invenio_product_code = hipc.invenio_product_code LEFT JOIN opera.fixing_table ft ON ft.tenant_id = d.tenant_id AND ft.business_unit = d.business_unit AND ft.trade_id = d.trade_id LEFT JOIN opera.underlying_settle_value_table usv_cm ON usv_cm.tenant_id = pm.tenant_id AND usv_cm.underlying_id = pm.curr_mult_factor AND usv_cm.value_date = v.value_date LEFT JOIN opera.underlying_settle_value_table usv_u1 ON usv_u1.tenant_id = si.tenant_id AND usv_u1.underlying_id = si.underlying1_id AND usv_u1.value_date = v.value_date LEFT JOIN opera.underlying_actual_value_table uav_cm ON uav_cm.tenant_id = pm.tenant_id AND uav_cm.underlying_id = pm.curr_mult_factor AND uav_cm.value_date = v.value_date LEFT JOIN opera.underlying_actual_value_table uav_u1 ON uav_u1.tenant_id = si.tenant_id AND uav_u1.underlying_id = si.underlying1_id AND uav_u1.value_date = v.value_date WHERE d.tenant_id = h.tenant_id AND d.business_unit = h.business_unit AND d.trade_id = h.source_trade_id AND LOWER(d.business_unit) IN ('cfs', 'rov', 'cto', 'orm', 'osg', 'rmc') ) b WHERE LOWER(b.derivative_type) IN ('fx_vanilla_call', 'fx_vanilla_put') OR ( LOWER(b.derivative_type) NOT IN ('fx_vanilla_call', 'fx_vanilla_put') AND LOWER(b.curr_mult_type) IN ('multiplication', 'division') AND b.is_fixing_done IN (0, 1) ) ) fx ON true WHERE h.tenant_id = :tenant AND h.business_unit IN ('orm', 'osg', 'rmc', 'ORM', 'OSG', 'RMC')

rules.sql: WITH cmv AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT * FROM opera.curr_mult_view WHERE tenant_id = :tenant), ccmv AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT * FROM opera.cloned_curr_mult_view WHERE tenant_id = :tenant), mxv AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT * FROM opera.murex_nc_factor_view WHERE tenant_id = :tenant), sp AS ( SELECT s.tenant_id, s.business_unit, s.security_id, pm1.asset_class, pm1.invenio_product_code, pm1.product_name, pm1.exchange_name, pm1.lot_mult AS lot_mult1, cm1.curr_mult AS curr_mult1, pm1.murex_mult AS mult_factor, mx.murex_nc_factor AS nc_factor FROM opera.cloned_security_info_table s JOIN opera.valuation_date_table v ON v.tenant_id = s.tenant_id AND v.business_unit = s.business_unit LEFT JOIN opera.cloned_underlying_list_table u1 ON u1.tenant_id = s.tenant_id AND u1.underlying_id = s.underlying1_id LEFT JOIN opera.cloned_underlying_list_table u2 ON u2.tenant_id = s.tenant_id AND u2.underlying_id = s.underlying2_id LEFT JOIN cmv cm1 ON cm1.tenant_id = s.tenant_id AND cm1.business_unit = s.business_unit AND cm1.invenio_product_code = s.product_code AND cm1.value_date = v.value_date LEFT JOIN opera.product_master_table pm1 ON pm1.tenant_id = s.tenant_id AND pm1.invenio_product_code = s.product_code LEFT JOIN ccmv cm2 ON cm2.tenant_id = s.tenant_id AND cm2.business_unit = s.business_unit AND cm2.invenio_product_code = u2.invenio_product_code AND cm2.value_date = v.value_date LEFT JOIN opera.cloned_product_master_table pm2 ON pm2.tenant_id = s.tenant_id AND pm2.invenio_product_code = u2.invenio_product_code LEFT JOIN mxv mx ON mx.tenant_id = s.tenant_id AND mx.business_unit = s.business_unit AND mx.invenio_product_code = s.product_code AND mx.value_date = v.value_date WHERE s.tenant_id = :tenant AND s.business_unit IN ('orm', 'osg', 'rmc', 'ORM', 'OSG', 'RMC') ) SELECT h.uuid::text AS row_id, h.business_unit, h.security_id, h.source_trade_id, sp.asset_class, sp.invenio_product_code, sp.product_name, sp.exchange_name, sp.lot_mult1, sp.curr_mult1, sp.mult_factor, sp.nc_factor FROM opera.helper_settle_p_and_g_view_cache_table h LEFT JOIN sp ON sp.tenant_id = h.tenant_id AND sp.business_unit = h.business_unit AND sp.security_id = h.security_id WHERE h.tenant_id = :tenant AND h.business_unit IN ('orm', 'osg', 'rmc', 'ORM', 'OSG', 'RMC')

SELECT h.uuid::text AS row_id, h.business_unit, h.security_id, h.source_trade_id, fx.fx_nc_factor, fx.actual_fx_nc_factor FROM opera.helper_settle_p_and_g_view_cache_table h LEFT JOIN opera.fx_nc_factor_view fx ON fx.tenant_id = h.tenant_id AND fx.business_unit = h.business_unit AND fx.trade_id = h.source_trade_id WHERE h.tenant_id = :tenant AND h.business_unit IN ('orm', 'osg', 'rmc', 'ORM', 'OSG', 'RMC')
